fact: A NUST master's thesis evaluates the government's Pocket Guide 2.0 Pocket Bot AI chatbot as a digital self-service tool for civil servants, based on interviews with 20 civil servants who used it.
The Prime Minister said the launched Digital Pocket Guide 2.0 has an AI chatbot, Pocketbot, through which civil servants ask questions and receive instant answers on public service HR policies.

UNDP Namibia says the Office of the Prime Minister and UNDP launched the Being a Public Servant Digital Pocket Guide 2.0 on 24 November 2023, using generative AI with its own Pocket Bot for public servants.
